design_rationale:
WORKLOG / TEST DOSSIER - moving_truck_rentals task 1 (figures are the output of /tmp/run_0051/moving_truck_rentals/calc_t1.py, which replays the gold writes with the real tools and evaluates each compute with check_compute's primitives at its handling time).

[Step 0 - draw and scope] draw_counts.py --task 1 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 1, "problems": 2, "factor_counts": [6, 5]}. Assignment: truck_ext_first_day_rate 6 factors, truck_ext_signing_authorization_hold (root) 5. Occupied by task 0: truck_ext_late_cancellation_fee, truck_ext_additional_day_charge, truck_ext_move_in_mileage_allowance, truck_ext_move_in_rental_waiver and their four tools (return-day and free move-in side). Claimed here: the pickup side - the first-day rental fee posted when a contract opens (post_first_day_rental_fee_f35b099c, agent) and the authorization hold placed when the renter signs (sign_truck_rental_contract_074f2414, owner=user). Both subjects (truck_pickup, truck_deposit_hold) are untouched by task 0; with this task every extended policy of the difficulty is claimed exactly once and nothing is reserved.

[Why this is a good test] The caller only wants to pick up his reserved cargo van. The hold he signs for is not the flat card deposit: the policy states that it is fixed only after the contract's first-day rental fee stands posted, and the van's reservation carries no fee line. The agent must first price the first day - the rating day (a three-day booking from Friday to Monday takes in the weekend, so it is rated as a Saturday, not as the Friday pickup), tenancy at this facility, the 14-day advance booking, the military discount on his storage agreement and his active ACH AutoPay (not the credit-card authorization he cancelled in 2023) - then compute the hold from the card on file, his storage ledger (a reversed payment in March, no late fee), his tenancy, his veteran discount, the booking lead and a day-based rental estimate for the two booked days after the first, adding the first-day fee just posted, and hand the contract to him to sign with that hold.

[Problem-tree card] root = truck_ext_signing_authorization_hold. One edge: root -> truck_ext_first_day_rate, kind value_input, gate first_day_fee_posted, form state, prerequisite sentence "The authorization hold is fixed only after the contract's first-day rental fee stands posted on the contract." (affirmative; task 0's sentences supply the negated direction, so the charter carries both). Four-point test: ordering connective 'only after'; waits on a record-visible state (a base rental fee line for the first day on the contract); names no tool, id or code token; hard requirement scoped to the contract being signed. Exactly one write of the difficulty posts a contract's first-day line: post_first_day_rental_fee_f35b099c (the additional-day tool posts later days at check-in on returned contracts). Opening fact: initial_state.truck_rentals.<T> is reserved with balance 0.00 and the contract carries no truck_charges rows at all. Resolved by the agent; the root is the renter's own act (signing the contract is the renter's act per the blueprint), handed over after the fee is posted. Deletion sensitivity: skipping the first-day fee leaves the hold at 157.90 instead of 175.86 (first_day_fee_posted 0.00) and the contract without its fee line. user_scenario never mentions a fee, a rate or a hold rule; it states only the pickup. No tool checks the edge.

[Base-invariant card] First-day fee (subject truck_pickup): truck_evt_pricing (policy_scope) and truck_evt_driver_requirements.driver_age - "The renter's age is judged from the date of birth on the customer profile." DOB 1975-11-02 -> 50 years at 2026-10-16, above min_driver_age_years 18 of the Cargo Van; the renter on the reservation is the caller (customer_id bound). Signing (subjects truck_pickup, truck_deposit_hold): the same two plus truck_evt_deposit_and_settlement.hold_once - "A hold is placed once per contract." The contract carries no hold before signing; the first truck_charges row on it is the step-7 fee line (evidence prior_step:7). No time gate applies to either write (none of these policies has a kind=time eligibility on these subjects). Cargo Van accepted_deposit_methods include debit_card, the card on file.

[Business-object card] Target: reservation T (Bluegate Cargo Van, PHX-031, booked 2026-10-02 for Friday 2026-10-16 09:30 to Monday 2026-10-19 09:30, debit card on file). Evidence rows: storage agreement J-108 (Drive-Up Standard 10x15, PHX-031, moved in 2023-06-14, military discount applied, own insurance), its ledger (14 monthly rent charges of 125.10 = 139.00 less the 10 percent military discount, 14 ACH payments, the 2026-03-14 payment reversed 2026-03-17 with a 30.00 returned-payment fee and repaid 155.10 by debit card on 2026-03-18 inside the grace period, so no late fee), AutoPay (Personal Checking ACH, active, enrolled 2026-10-15, verified 2026-10-16, first draft 2026-11-14, no drafts yet; an older Credit Card authorization enrolled 2023-06-14 and cancelled 2023-06-30 before any draft). No other truck contract exists.

[Factor card]
 First-day fee (6): rating day (method) - booked three days, Friday to Monday, taking in Saturday and Sunday -> rated as a Saturday instead of the Friday pickup (baseline scheduled weekday -> 16.47); weekday rate - Saturday -> 1.2 (baseline 1.0 -> 14.97); tenant discount (multi-source, cross-difficulty unit) - 40 months at PHX-031 -> 0.15 (-> 22.45); advance discount - booked 14 days ahead -> 0.10 (-> 20.96); military discount (cross-difficulty unit tier parameter) - larger of 0.10 and 0.05 = 0.10 (-> 20.96); AutoPay discount (cross-difficulty autopay) - active Personal Checking ACH -> 0.05 (-> 19.46). Fee = 24.95 x 1.2 x (1 - 0.40) = 17.964 -> 17.96; all-baseline 24.95. Near-miss: the cancelled 2023 Credit Card AutoPay authorization; counting it as his authorization gives the card tier 0.03 (18.56).
 Hold (5): payment-risk multiple (multi-source: debit card on file AND a storage payment reversed 2026-03-17, within 12 months) -> 1.5 (baseline 1.0 -> 139.86); tenant share (cross-difficulty unit) - 40 months at PHX-031 and no late fee in 12 months (the 30.00 fee is a returned-payment fee, not a late fee: the near-miss) -> 0.5 (-> 283.86); military share - active agreement with the military discount -> 0.8 (-> 202.86); booking-lead share - 14 days -> 0.9 (-> 187.86); rental estimate (method) - three booked days -> day-based 2 x 24.95 = 49.90 (a same-day booking would use a 40-mile estimate instead) (-> 125.96). Hold = 200.00 x 1.5 x 0.5 x 0.8 x 0.9 + 17.96 + 49.90 = 108.00 + 67.86 = 175.86; all-baseline 200.00 + 17.96 = 217.96.

[Seed design] Profile, one storage agreement with 14 months of ledger history (31 rows), one active ACH AutoPay with no drafts yet, one reservation. No waiver or extra driver will be taken (persona declines), so no waiver or additional-driver fee is lit; the reservation (Friday 09:30 to Monday 09:30) is 10 minutes past its pickup, far from the no-show cutoff of 2 hours.

[Persona] Hurried, friendly; volunteers only that he wants to pick up the van; states identity, van readings and choices only when asked; signs when handed the contract; ends on the picked-up confirmation, which is the last gold write.

[Standard solution] find_customers by phone -> verify (DOB + photo ID last four) -> read the reservation, the storage agreement, the storage ledger and AutoPay -> post the first-day fee 17.96 -> hand over the contract; the renter signs with fleet number PHX-CV-4413, odometer 31842, fuel 8, waiver none, 0 extra drivers and hold 175.86.

[Revision 3 - policy-task audit round 2] F-2: first-day duration rate relabelled parameter; the advance-booking discount is replaced by a genuine method (rating day: reservation-date weekday for bookings 14+ days ahead, next day for evening pickups, scheduled date otherwise); the hold's mileage estimate became a source-switching rental estimate (mileage-based for same-day bookings, class rate per extra booked day for multi-day bookings). F-4: the first-day rule and its tool docstring no longer mention the signature. F-5: the military tier takes the larger of the class rate and military_former_discount. T1-F2: a near-miss record added (the cancelled 2023 credit-card AutoPay). Reservation date moved to 2026-10-02 so the rating day bites. Figures now 11.53 / 155.13, recomputed by calc_t1.py.
[Revision 4 - policy-task audit round 3] R2-F2: the reservation-weekday rating tier is withdrawn. The rating-day method now follows how rental counters price multi-day rentals: a booking of three or more days is rated as its busiest booked day (a Saturday if it takes in a weekend, otherwise a Friday if it takes in one), an evening pickup under three days is rated on the next day, anything else on the pickup day. To keep every factor bearing weight on a realistic world the booking became Friday 09:30 to Monday 09:30 (frozen 2026-10-16 09:40 MST), the same-day duration factor was withdrawn (no same-day booking any more) and the 14-day advance-booking discount restored; the hold's rental estimate now takes its day-based tier. Scored values moved: first-day fee 11.53 -> 17.96, hold 155.13 -> 175.86.
[Verification] calc_t1.py output reproduced in computations; per-task gates run after writing (results in the final report of this run). Draft from the visible context: the hold policy's prerequisite sentence and the empty contract ledger force the fee first; every factor tier is readable from the finders' outputs.

[Manual values gates - task 1] Length/breadth: surface goal (pick up the van) -> hold policy's prerequisite sentence -> empty contract ledger -> first-day pricing (6 factors over date, class, unit, autopay records) -> hold (5 factors over card on file, storage ledger, tenancy, military, lead, rental estimate); removing the edge changes the hold (157.90 vs 175.86). The owner=user tool is the signing itself: only the renter can sign his contract and authorize a hold on his own card, on the spot. Simulator boundary: he states the goal, answers when asked, signs when handed over, accepts the quoted hold, never raises fees or rules and asks nothing else. Opening chronology: every volunteered fact (reservation for today, at the lot) is in initial_state. Base eligibility: driver_age from the profile DOB; hold_once true (no hold row); no time gate. Business object: the single reservation; no other truck contract. No real-world wait: both writes complete under 2026-10-16 09:40 MST. Prerequisite sentence: affirmative 'only after', record-visible state, no code token, hard requirement on that contract; exactly one write (the first-day fee tool) produces a first-day line. Rule/compute: every ladder tier is stated in the rule with its condition and value/method; tiers are disjoint (thresholds stated as ranges). Factors: each baseline is what the computation document states (class rate; card deposit plus posted fee) and each factor moves the result on this world (sensitivity figures above). Draft from visible context agrees with gold.

[Difficulty-level closing] Six extended policies, claimed once each: task 0 = late cancellation fee, additional-day charge, move-in mileage allowance, move-in rental waiver; task 1 = first-day rate, signing authorization hold; tools likewise disjoint (4 + 2), both tasks call one owner=user tool (reservation cancellation; contract signing). Charter prerequisite sentences: two negated, two affirmative. Final gate block (round 1): EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK, SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK (history_rows_max 8, branches_max 64, means branches 49 / steps 13), GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK; check_traceability deferred until the KB is rendered. Base-layer note: truck_evt_free_move_in's window wording for reserved units relies on a scheduled move-in date the schema leaves empty while reserved; no task exercises a reserved unit, so no workaround was needed. The validator reports only required-document-not-found errors for this difficulty, expected before rendering.
user_scenario: You are Desmond Rourke, a retired Army vehicle mechanic who restores old furniture on weekends. It is Friday morning and you are standing next to a white Bluegate cargo van on the lot of the Bluegate facility where you keep your drive-up unit J-108. You speak in short, friendly sentences and you are in a bit of a hurry because a seller is waiting for you across town. You open with: "Morning. I'm at your lot to pick up the cargo van I reserved for this weekend, and the self-pickup screen in the app won't let me finish. Can you get me on the road?" You want to drive the van away on this call, and you are fine with the agent setting up whatever is needed on their side; anything that has to be signed by you, you will sign yourself in the app when the agent hands it over. You give your details only when the agent asks: the mobile number on your profile is 6025554182, your date of birth is 1975-11-02, and the last four characters of your photo ID are 4417; if a third detail is wanted, your billing ZIP code is 85017. If the agent asks about the van, the key tag reads PHX-CV-4413, the odometer shows 31842 miles and the fuel gauge is full, eight eighths. You booked it two weeks ago for the weekend - picking it up this morning and bringing it back Monday morning at 9:30 - to haul pieces from an estate sale, with the debit card you booked with. If you are asked about coverage, you decline any damage waiver and say you will be careful, and nobody else will drive the van. If the agent asks about your unit, you have had J-108 here since June 2023 and it carries your veteran discount; you had AutoPay on a credit card for a couple of weeks back in 2023 and stopped it, and you recently signed up for AutoPay from your checking account after a bank mix-up in March bounced one of your rent payments, which you paid by phone the next day. You do not know how the rate or the hold is worked out and you do not ask for a breakdown; if the agent tells you the hold amount on your card, you say that is fine. When the agent hands the contract over to you to sign, you sign it in the app using the van details you gave and the hold amount the agent tells you, and you read back the confirmation if asked. Once the confirmation shows the van as picked up, you thank the agent and end the call.
